# strlen

Returns a length of string.

## Format

```ttl
strlen <string>
```

## Remarks

Returns the length of &lt;string&gt; in the system variable "result".
The length counts in terms of bytes.

## Example

```ttl
strlen Txcnt
if result>0 then
	logwrite Txcnt
else
	messagebox 'Txcnt is NULL' 'error'
endif
```
